Subject: Orchard site visit week — demo slot confirmation

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for agreeing to run a focused run-through of Redwood during our site visit the week of Aug 10. We confirmed travel for our Ops and IT folks on Tues–Thu (Aug 11–13). We'd like a 45–60 minute session that includes a walkthrough of Dedicated capacity and a quick discussion of security controls with our IT lead (Tony).

Can you confirm an available slot on Aug 11 between 10:00–14:00 PT? If that window doesn't work, we have a hard stop as the team is flying out midday on Aug 13.

Appreciate it —
Sam

Hi Sam / team —

Thanks for the details and the agenda — looks great. Quick heads up: one of our engineers who owns the Dedicated capacity demo is out for a scheduled conference travel day on Aug 11 morning and won't be back until late afternoon. We still want to give you a tight, high-value session while ensuring Tony gets his security questions answered. A few options from our side: 

1) Move the live demo to Aug 11 at 15:00 PT — compressed 45-minute walkthrough focused on your top-priority scenarios (we'd record the session end-to-end).
2) Keep Aug 11 morning for a 30-minute high-level product + roadmap call and schedule a 60-minute deep demo on Aug 12 (first half focused on Dedicated perf/cost controls, second half on security).
3) If your travel plans are strict, we can run a 30-minute hands-on recording tailored to your agenda and then hold a 30-minute live Q&A (short) that Tony can join from the airport on Aug 13.

I recommend option 2 to balance depth and availability, but happy to adapt — what works best for you?

Also looping Karthik and Monica to confirm internal availability for the technical deep dive and to prep a targeted demo script that matches the agenda you attached.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick options. Given how tight our travel is (and Tony needs at least 30 min for the security checklist), we choose option 2: a 30-minute overview on Aug 11 at 10:30 PT (covers product fit + roadmap) and a 60-minute deep technical demo on Aug 12 at 09:30 PT with Karthik and Monica.
